title: Stoner Font
description: Custom Stoner Font for your Stoner Dark
body:
The ultimate sleek, custom-designed typeface for Minecraft 1.21.

Crafted specifically for players who prefer a clean, modern, and dark-themed aesthetic. It replaces the standard pixelated text with a bold, high-visibility font that perfectly complements dark mode resource packs.

✨ Key Features:
Modern UI Support: Perfectly fits any modern or dark layout.
High Visibility: Bold characters that are easy to read in any environment.
1.21 Ready: Fully compatible with all Minecraft 1.21 versions.
Best Pair: Designed to be used with [Stoner Dark Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stoner-dark).
